scope: All Python files listed in scripts/archive/MANIFEST.json
interpretation: A semantic disposition records where reusable value lives. It is not deletion permission and it does not alter the archived file's evidentiary scope.

dispositions.extraction-source-and-worked-example: Contains a reusable kernel now consumed by live library code; retains source-specific orchestration as a worked example.
dispositions.already-extracted-worked-example: Durable algorithms already live in tested library modules; the script documents their composition in one historical application.
dispositions.certificate-orchestration: Builds or verifies a source-specific certificate using live library code; retain for reproducibility, not as a general API.
dispositions.historical-orchestration: Owns scheduling, artifact formatting, rendering or parameter selection rather than a stranded mathematical algorithm.
dispositions.known-system-control: A reproducible calibration or negative control whose value is methodological rather than a new general theorem.
dispositions.provenance-repair: Repairs or normalizes a historical run record; reusable only as provenance for that record.
dispositions.solver-supervision-provenance: Pins a particular governed solver launch; generic supervision belongs to run_research.py.
dispositions.source-specific-probe: Contains substantial reasoning tied to one closed source system; retain as a possible future extraction source, but do not present it as a general tool.

promoted_abstractions.boundary: Only the exact matching and deletion-minimization kernel is architecture-independent. The MIP/SAT masters, translation actions and taper dual are V4-specific worked applications.
Proposal ranking from observed patch returns remains a historical candidate-specific heuristic.
The large runner composes exact component, parent, contact and equivalence modules; its level choices and artifact schema are a worked Spectre control.
Reference generation and spectrum primitives are reusable. The numerical thresholds and false-positive campaign are historical calibration, not an exact certificate or general theorem.

clusters.rationale: Five independent solver formulations share exact deletion-minimal obstruction and demand-matching logic. That kernel is now a tested general API; the remaining masters and symmetry actions are specific to the Layer-D V4 system.

These scripts compare LP/MIP, conflict-graph, marking, local-density and torus-to-plane formulations for one V4 obstruction problem. Core affine, packing, marking and orbit operations already live in src/einstein/holonomy/alternating4/; the remaining logic is formulation-specific and is retained for future theorem-guided extraction.

These select census levels, merge streams, render outputs or schedule the A0-A6 funnel. Enumeration, torus, Heesch, patch, diffraction and hierarchy algorithms are already library modules or compiled engines. The scripts preserve the exact historical campaign but are not the reusable implementation boundary.

These reproduce and stress-test the known Turtle finalist. Exact torus, patch, diffraction and hierarchy routines are library code; the candidate choice, escalation schedule and galleries remain a historically useful negative control, not a discovery route.
This normalizes one interrupted campaign's logs and has no mathematical API to promote.
This is a broad calibration and false-positive study around reusable spectrum/reference modules. Its floats, thresholds and campaign sizes deliberately remain outside the exact certificate path.

The formulas and exact cold checks live in k16w_exact.py and k16w_tangent.py. These three files pin particular cell batches, limits and failure records; generic governed launch responsibility now belongs to scripts/run_research.py.

These serialize bounded quotient, invariant, holonomy and proof campaigns. The reusable transfer, invariant, finite-group, holonomy, symmetry and cold-verifier implementations are live modules. Index choices and artifact layouts remain certificate provenance.

These apply the live V4 SFT, lift, packing, product and density modules to fixed quotient families and package witnesses or proof artifacts. Their durable algorithms are already extracted; their value here is exact reproducibility.

The scripts compose tested Spectre geometry, contact, component, parent, CSP and equivalence modules into specific radius and hierarchy artifacts. Their substantial value is preserved as reproducible applications; the live spectre_*.py modules are the reusable boundary.
This packages the exact Golden/Sturmian Turtle anchor implemented in turtle_sturmian.py. It remains an external-method calibration and does not define the active Sturmian realization problem.
